comment: Each output's trigger length is scaled against that output's own period (meterx.cpp:57), so a setting of 50 per cent is half of a twenty-fourth of a quarter note at the top jack and half of a hundred and twenty-eight bars at the bottom one. The module has no parameters or inputs of its own; everything comes over the expander connection from the Meter to its left.
